svg.text: Laser board, sheet 4 of 4: ESP32-S3 DevKit and outputs
The DevKit sits on two 1 × 22 sockets. Its supply is the Pi's USB: its 5V and 3V3 pins connect to nothing here.
J1 and J3 are the DevKit's own header names; pin 1 of each is at the antenna end.
SPARE18, SPARE41: a pad each. USB to the Pi on the port marked USB (GPIO19/20), not UART.
D1, D2: fitted for a fan or relay; a lamp does not need one.
J10, J12, J13 are 3-pin with the middle pin unused, so a laser's
2-pin plug pushed into one meets a single live pin at most.
Lamp and aux together: about 0.2 A, within F1.
